title: Challenge Death
description: This plugin automatically switches everyone to spectator mode when a player dies—perfect for hardcore challenges.
body:
# [Discord](https://discord.gg/Xw86rqWWcW)

**This plugin automatically switches everyone to spectator mode when a player dies.**

**This plugin is well-suited for challenges involving multiple players.**

### How it works:

When a player dies, everyone is automatically switched to spectator mode.

**If you have any ideas, improvements or feedback, feel free to tell us about them on our Discord server.**
